name: Team Bulbasaur: Plain Badge Precision
archetype: Sleep control, Intimidate attack reduction, and Fighting wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Whitney's 5v5 challenge prompts the player to pick 5 Pokémon: Kingler/Primeape serves as the primary offensive wallbreaker, obliterating Normal types with super-effective Close Combat; Gyarados/Arbok enters to trigger Intimidate and paralyze fast threats like Tauros with Glare; Snorlax matches Whitney's heavyweights in endurance with Rest and Body Slam; Venusaur/Charizard shuts down Chansey/Miltank's Rollout momentum with accurate Sleep Powder; and Alakazam/Weezing targets low special defenses with STAB Psychic.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter anchor. Sleep Powder immediately stops Chansey/Miltank from stacking Rollout turns or healing with Milk Drink.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Cuts Aipom/Tauros Attack stat upon entry. Glare inflicts 100% accurate paralysis on speedy Normal sweepers.
495 BST special sweeper with 118 SpA. Bypasses high physical Defense walls like Chansey/Miltank using special STAB Psychic.
500 BST physical destroyer. STAB Close Combat delivers catastrophic super-effective damage to Whitney's entire Normal-type roster.
Colossal 160 HP tank. Absorbs stray Metronome and Hyper Beam hits effortlessly, recovering to full health with Rest and Sleep Talk.
High-Speed Flying scout. Immune to Ground moves and provides team-wide Tailwind speed doubles if needed during route exploration.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against bulky route trainers.
High-speed Electric coverage packing Discharge and Light Screen against Water hybrids.
High Jump Kick physical breaker capable of substituting into the active party for Fighting STAB.
